description_en: Creates a task to upload an Object Storage Service (OSS) file and obtain the key of the task
description_zh: 创建上传OSS附件任务，获得附件任务Key
kebab_example: aliyun dms-enterprise create-upload-oss-file-job --file-source datacorrect --file-name test.sql --upload-target BucketName=test_bucket Endpoint=http://oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com ObjectName=test.sql --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateUploadOSSFileJob

parameters.help_en:
The purpose of the file upload task. Valid values:

datacorrect: The file is uploaded to change data.
order_info_attachment: The file is uploaded as an attachment in a ticket.
big-file: The file is uploaded to import multiple data records at a time.
sqlreview: The file is uploaded for SQL review
parameters.help_zh:
上传附件的使用目的，取值和说明如下：
datacorrect：数据变更工单
order_info_attachment：工单附件
big-file：批量数据导入
sqlreview：SQL审核
parameters.name: file_source

parameters.help_en:
The name of the file.

The file name must end with .txt or .sql. For example, the file name can be text.txt
parameters.help_zh:
文件名。
需要以txt、sql结尾，例如test.txt
parameters.name: file_name

fields.help_en: The name of the OSS bucket
fields.name: bucket_name

fields.help_en: The endpoint of the OSS bucket
fields.name: endpoint

fields.help_en: The name of the OSS object
fields.name: object_name

parameters.help_en: The information about the OSS file to be uploaded
parameters.name: upload_target

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the ID of the tenant, move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management (DMS) console. For more information, see the "View information about the current tenant" section of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html topic
parameters.name: tid

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request failed

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request failed

JobKey.description_en: The key of the file upload task. You can query the upload progress and task details. For more information, see [GetUserUploadFileJob]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html）
JobKey.description_zh: 上传附件任务Key，可查询附件上传进展与任务详情，详情请参见[GetUserUploadFileJob]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html）

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
